Low: Sling Bag Small $35; Sling Bag $45; Moon Bag Large $49; Tote Bag Large $84; high: Cloud Tote Bag and Puffer Horizon Tote Bag $99. Backpacks sit in a separate collection: in the full store feed (https://us.got-bag.com/products.json?limit=250) regular-price backpacks run from Rolltop Easy $105 to Pro Pack Travel $199 (Daypack 2.0 is marked down). Like-for-like: carry bags at regular price, in stock (reusable/shopping bags, totes, shoulder and crossbody bags, belt/hip bags, backpacks); luggage, duffels and weekenders, pouches, organisers, wallets, straps, charms, lunch boxes excluded.

notes: Global store meta: GOT BAG, Mainz, Germany, EUR (https://got-bag.com/meta.json); US store run by GOT BAG North America Inc., Beaverton, Oregon, ships to the US only (https://us.got-bag.com/meta.json, https://us.got-bag.com/pages/terms-of-service). 'Every GOT BAG product is made with recycled primary materials', including RE:PET from coastal plastic waste collected by GOT BAG Indonesia's clean-up and RE:NYNET from retired fishing nets (https://us.got-bag.com/pages/faq). GOT BAG GmbH is certified to the Global Recycled Standard (https://us.got-bag.com/pages/certificates-and-awards).

US shipping from warehouses in Oregon or Las Vegas; free ground shipping on $75+. Returns of unused items within 30 days; no exchanges online (return and reorder); final sale and international orders not returnable (https://us.got-bag.com/policies/shipping-policy, https://us.got-bag.com/policies/refund-policy). Sling Bag: 'compact crossbody bag with smart organization, an adjustable strap, and water-repellent material' (products.json).
